Hello, Brick-Soldiers! This is a story which is about Nilezz's map, "Babel" and I decided to make a story about it! I find the map really amazing and beautiful as I decided to make a story about it!

Chapter 1: Rough Morning

It’s the time where it will be Nilez’s 2 weeks of training and attending to the ZombKing’s Military Company with his friends and other elder soldiers like Tails, Glotzi, Kalchas, and the famous and the leader of the military, Eazzy. Eazzy is very famous and takes full control of his ZombKing’s clan and territory. They are the master of the undead and expert survival in the Zombie Apocalypse. But, this is his 3rd time waking and getting up late for the next test and training. He slowly opens his eyes as his visions is blurry then sharpens, he sees a clock as it seems to be 11:30 AM. “Oh, Nein! I’m late again!” He quickly gets up from bed as he wears his own uniform then looks himself in the mirror at the bathroom. He quickly brushes his teeth and wash his face nice and clean, because simply looking nice and neat is always a good manner for a boy like him. Nilez then head downstairs to the dining room, where at the dining table there’s seems to be an already-made sandwich on the plate sitting on top of the plate. It also has a message on small, folded paper next to the plate:

“Rough Morning again, Nilez? Don’t slack off this time.” – Kagome 0625

That’s right. His roommate is Kagome 0625, the brother of the Kagome 0615 and the archrival of Badaboom. He is the fastest and the deadliest soldiers than any soldiers they may remember. His high affinity for guns is apparent for him, but for others: They just want to make sure that he won’t get crazy with it. Nilez quickly bites and chomps down the sandwich as he immediately drank a nice water from the fridge at the Kitchen as he immediately went outside of the house then shuts the door. The door automatically locks on its own as he immediately sprints and run towards the meeting camp. Today there will be an important briefing for their next mission. 30 minutes later after he sprinted over 10 miles with no rest, he finally manages to reach to the ZombKing’s training ground. He enters as he noticed that all of the tents and training activity are completely empty and quiet, which mean obviously of course the meeting has seems to be in progress.

“Oh mein Gott. I’m so in big trouble for being late again” says Nilez inside of his mind. He stops in front of the Meeting Tent (which is so huge and large that it looks like a circus tent), closes his eyes then takes a deep breath. He slowly opens the tent flap then slowly peeks in. There, he sees Badaboom, Tails, Kalchas, Glotzauge, Kagome, and the rest of the ZombKing’s well-known soldiers and staff, sitting on the chair in front of a wide, wooden table where there’s a map of their today’s briefing and mission. Eazzy was standing on the middle as he lays both of his hands on the map as he then faces his head towards Nilez. “Oh, well… you’re late again. But at least you didn’t miss the important things about our next mission” said Eazzy. “Please, take a deep breath and relax. Your seat is waiting for you, as we will finish on the basic briefing and get to an important one." Nilez slowly and timidly nods as he slowly goes around the briefing session then sits down on his designated seat, which is on his left is Kagome and on his right, is Badaboom. Nilez do noticed that Kagome isn’t actually part of the ZombKing’s clan, but he is officially part of the Kagome’s clan which he doesn’t know much more about it. But, he decided and wanted to help us which is so nice to hear. None of the ZombKing’s soldiers never wanted to fight him forever. Except Badaboom, because obviously, he’s an archrival of Kagome’s and he have no problem with it.

Chapter 1. Kagome’s PoV.

It’s been another day, another time where Nilez is late again. It has been 2 weeks of attending to this nice and well-known military clan. I presume that being his roommate and trying to keep him away from trouble is my type of things. I usually love to help a new recruit and do my best to become a well-known helpful person like Melody. Melody and I are well-known soldiers who loves to help people and do our best to keep everything in good-environment state. But for now, maybe I really should have not leave Nilez alone, sleeping on his bed and prepares his sandwich on the table early to go and not to miss this briefing. But, this one is considered important so I had no choice but to leave him. The conversation of the ZombKing’s soldiers continues to talk until Eazzy, the leader of the ZombKing’s clan approaches in, stands in front of the wide, briefing table then lays both of his hand on top of the briefing table as he seems a bit frustrated and not feeling okay.

“We have some good news and bad news…” says Eazzy. “Give us a good news first” says Badaboom, “No, give us a bad news first” I quickly add. Because simply hearing the bad news first then the good news is really nice you know. Sometime hearing the bad news after the good news just make you feel helpless and lose hope. But Kalchas glares at both of us as he then speaks seriously “It’s best to let the leader to talk. He does not need an option on which he must do from us. Let him do what he must do.” We keep our mouth shuts as we all turn our heads towards Eazzy. “The good news is that we found more of this Divine Flame.” He places a glass bottle with a cork plugged in at the table. Inside the clear, glass bottle it has living flame which has the color mixture of Cyan and White. This Divine Flame was considered a greatest fuel for engineering, a very large stove, and of course for a powerful steam engines. Then, Eazzy says the bad news, “The bad news is that we could not find more of this Divine Flame forever now in this world.”

We both jeers and looked at each other in such a shocked and frightened expression. The real purpose of this fuel is that it’s our current and well-used fuel that is used to power up the powerful steam engine (which I mentioned earlier) called the Divine Motor Core. It is used to power up the whole territory’s power for the ZombKing’s clan. We can go for Argent Energy or other source of energy to power up this land, but those are very extremely risky and dangerous. So, heating and cooking up that engine is the only option we have. That small Divine Flame is worth cooking about 3 tons of coals that can cook up and keep the engine running for a year. But now here’s the total bad news that we all don’t wanted to hear: That this is our last Divine Flame that we could all find. I mean hey, I can just abandon this clan and go back to my clan. But, I presume I don’t want to disappoint Eazzy and Kalchas more because of this bad news.

30 minutes later, I began to hear the footstep that sounded so familiar to Nilez. It was then silence, until suddenly I see that Nilez slowly peeks in from the outside as he slowly walks in. Eazzy then looks at Nilez as he speaks, “Oh, well… you’re late again. But at least you didn’t miss the important things about our next mission” said Eazzy. “Please, take a deep breath and relax. Your seat is waiting for you, as we will finish on the basic briefing and get to an important one.” So, he nodded and sits down next to me, where on his right is Badaboom, my archrival that we never stop fighting and won’t stop fighting over on who can be the best soldier of the ZombKing’s clan. Even though I’m not officially part of the ZombKing’s clan, I still wanted to be an archrival with this guy.
Lol, your story Nilezz is so me xD

Chapter 2: The Message…

Eazzy stands up straight then stretches as he signals and uses hand gestures towards normal and non-staff ZombKing’s to dismiss from the briefing. Nilez is aware that this may be a mission for staffs and highly-trained professionals. Eazzy then start to looks serious on his face as he speaks, “The FirstBlood, Synage, Authority, and others clans we know as enemies starts to form a group of army as they are tempting to try and wipe us all out first as then they will go for each other.” Then Badaboom looks at Eazzy in such a disgusted look on his face “So you’re saying they’re first teaming on us then they’re going for a total deathmatch to them?” Eazzy slowly closes his eyes as he takes a deep breath, as he looks very disappointed and upset. “I presume so…” Eazzy replied. Then Kagome stood up as he curls his hands to fists as he speaks, “Then we shall be ready. And be ready to see if they underestimate the power of ZombKing’s! We’ll show them and prove them wrong! No one can underestimate the power of the ZombKing’s!” The other staff and strong soldiers agrees as they nodded. Nilez seems a bit scared but tries to swallow it in and be brave and fearless like how the other staffs are supposed to be. So, he nodded as he stands up speaks, “I’ll prepare the men and assembles the team and the defense, Eazzy!” Eazzy, obviously have no choice but relies on him anyway, agrees and accepts him to do it anyway.

Nilez, full of pride, gets up as he salutes to Eazzy. Eazzy salutes him back as Nilez then went out of the tent to assemble the team. Kagome however hesitantly stood up then speaks, “I’ll prepare the weapons even the Vulcan Series arsenal.” Then, Badaboom gets up as well, “Then I’ll prepare the Fancy and the Sci-Fi weapons as well!” Badaboom and Kagome glares at each other, but they need to remember that Kalchas is watching. They both turns away from each other as they all immediately get off the tent then prepares the weapons and to assist Nilez. Kagome first quickly approaches towards Nilez as he looks at his side. “First time seeing you be full of pride and being so confident, Nilez” said Kagome. “No need to be surprised, Kag. Tears rolling down to his cheeks behind his mask before he curls both of his hands to fists then clenches his teeth, not daring to let out a single sob or weep from his mouth. He turns around before folds his arms then lean against the tree behind him on his back.

Kagome: S-Shepard… But hey, his full name is a bit weird and strange but there’s a lot reason why he lives up to his name… “Shepard Carbon”.

Nilez: Shepard Carbon…? But why?

Kagome: Let’s just say that… he’s addicted to carbon and all those kinds of shenanigans…

Nilez finally finishes the cooked meat: Right… What now?

Kagome: We’re still proceeding forward. We still need to find a place to live… A village, a kingdom, or something… There got to be a government or a village just like where those tribes come from…

Nilez: I agree. Where’s my clothes?

Kagome slowly kneel down before he pulls out all of Nilez’s Special Force armor piece in miniature size from his backpack then passes them to Nilez. He stands up with a Lynx on his hand as he turns around and watches Nilez dressing himself up with full Special Force armor on. They proceed forward with their weapons lock and loaded after they put out the bonfire. Everything’s same as usual just like when they both travelled together. The trees are the same, the grasses are the same, the air smells and feels the same. Nilez wishes to go back home but he wonders if his other friends are also alive as well. He believes that most of his friends are alive and okay… or so it seems.

Meanwhile somewhere at the flat plain of this strange dimension. Badaboom was standing in the middle of the plain with multiple of wounds and some arrows stuck on his arms and back. Heavily damaged and angry as he stands and spins around with a Cirrus 85 on his hands firing like an angry gunner. There was Johnny behind him facing the other way with a Typhoon 8 on his hands and also firing with some of the arrows stuck on his back but a heavy axe wound on his right thigh. They both spun around like a circle while firing his weapon as multiple corpses of the fallen and shot-dead tribes surrounds Johnny and Badaboom. Multiple of empty clip beneath their feet and continuous bullets fired out of their weapons like there’s no tomorrow, defending their lives from an endless wave of tribes who have red, circular tattoo on their arms and a painting of a red skull on their faces where they are armed with a crimson axe, spear, or a bow and arrow.

Badaboom: They won’t stop coming…!

Johnny: That doesn’t matter now…! We just got to keep on fighting and defending our lives from these tribes...!

Badaboom: Killing almost around 3,000 of these tribes under 3 hours…?! But we’re starting to low on ammo...!

Johnny: I know...! We either fight or die…!

Badaboom: Can’t we just run, Johnny?!

Johnny: Not when we can’t find a clear path to run to from these tribes...!! We have t-

Suddenly an arrow was shot to Johnny’s back that went deeper than the other arrows as he collapses to the floor unconsciously with a groan.

Badaboom: JOHNNY…!!

He picks up Johnny’s Typhoon 8 from the ground before he dual wields Johnny’s and his weapon then continues to fire both of his weapons while shouting in rage, unaware of a strange red mist circling around him. Meanwhile back to Nilez and Kagome, they manage to reach a village with multiple of wooden hut and inns. Some buildings are a restaurant as others are some sort of a shop. Kagome hand gestures Nilez to proceed to the bar, but slowly and act like a normal human being.

Kagome: Don’t rush… We’re not in some sort of a tough mission where we have to run and take cover on every corner and object… Let’s just… proceed to the bar and get something to drink. Alright?

Nilez nods before they both proceed on, not daring to look back at the villagers and other travelers who look like a fine, normal person dressed in shirts and other former clothing but some has a strange tattoo on their arms in different colors. They proceed on with their weapon strapped on their back before they proceed through the double door of the bar where they could see some villagers enjoying themselves as they talk and eat their food together just like how normal people do back in New-Brick in most restaurant, except that the foods are different along with the people. There happens to be some monster humanoids like medusa, vampire, zombies, animal people, and other strange humanoid creatures.

They both stopped at the other side of the doorway to the inside of the bar as Kagome folds his arms: Ugh… It’s like we’re in some sort of a fantasy place where mythological and great fantasy creatures exist.

Nilez: Well it could make sense because of the… fruits and other encounters we’ve witnessed… Don’t they count as fantasy?

Kagome: I would consider this place an exotic or a super natural place if NONE of these kinds of beings exist. It’s like now we’re in some sort of a childish adventure for quest or some ****ing fantasy RPG game kind of ****.

Nilez: W-Woah, Kagome… There’s nothing need to be angry or bad about I mean… these peoples look nice and they talk nice… happen or somehow able to speak English and other languages and such but… Nilez then holds one of Kagome’s hand before he guides Kagome to an unoccupied table. T-Tell you what! I bet this is going to be fun and amazing…! I mean, I may be a timid soldier as always but I assure that something like this makes the experience interesting… and fun…!

Kagome then stops as he looks at some tough-looking wolf boys who is sitting on their seat facing each other as they glare at Kagome in a tough-looking way.

Kagome got both of his hands on his waist before he raises both of his hands up in the air then slams them against the wolf boy’s table loud and strong, scaring and threatening them: What are you all looking at, mother f****er?

Nilez quickly run towards Kagome before he grabs on Kagome’s hand then quickly guides him to a nearby unoccupied table: E-Easy, Kagome…! Easy…!

They both sat together at the same time as they face each other. Nilez was still curious about Kagome’s mask as he wonders what and how will his friends and others be doing. Kagome was wondering and curious about how Melody is doing and wondered if she’s also ended up in this kind of place as well. Leading them to this strange kind of place is a major question, it’s either because that they ended up in the center of the New-Brick, or it’s either because they were all teleported to this place as they leave the New-Brick destroyed and collapsed. However, Melody was currently at the same dimension Kagome is at as she sprints pass through the trees lightning speed as a corrupted Medelian with bother of her tendrils waving aggressively while being chased by the hunters who have yellow tattoos on their arms and a painting of a yellow fox on their face, armed with a spear.

Melody has no scratch nor damaged from anything since she arrived to this land. All she remembers that she suddenly got blacked out then woke up in this dimension untouched. She has bloods on her hands and the tip of her tendrils as she must have been defended her live from these hunters and other dangerous creatures. But nobody can easily kill or scratch Melody, because no peasants can’t even try to touch the princess. But except these hunters as they are fast as how Melody sprints, which annoys her a lot. As she continues to flee away from the hunters, she suddenly got caught up with a net that is made of thick abnormal and super natural spider silk thrown from the hunters who were waiting and hiding behind the trees straight to Melody’s direction. She struggles to break free from the net, but the net is too strong and thick that this is one of the strongest net that she ever caught up in her entire life. So, she yelps and cries for help as the hunters slowly approaches to her then begins poking her body with their spearhead painfully. She winces and yelps as they begin hurting and disturbing Melody, which however alerts the monster: Kagome.

Kagome quickly looks up with the bunny ears on his mask along with his real ear twitching rapidly, which surprises Nilez as he wasn’t expecting Kagome’s mask would do that. Nilez was currently finishing his food which it happens to be a scrambled egg of a strange creature (that isn’t chicken) and a sausage of some wild beast. He then tilts his head and look at Kagome in a curious look on his face.

Nilez: U-Uhh.. Kagome? Are you okay?

By the time he blinks, Kagome disappeared right before his eyes in front of him. Startling and surprising Nilez.

Nilez: W-Woah…!! Kagome…?!! Kagome! Where did you go?!!

Kagome quickly phase through all of the object as tentacles slowly grows out of his back while sprinting in the speed of 50 mach. His entire body slowly turns to crimson as a powerful bright white warp in a shape of a sphere with a red rim surrounding the edge of the sphere sticks on his body and begins to cover his entire body. He then finally transforms himself into a crimson Medelian that no other Medelian can reach this level and power, Altair Medelian. With his wide-opened radiant white eyes and wide-opened mouth with three pairs of teeth of a great white shark, he laughs as crimson liquid substance melts out of his body but sticks on his entire body before it begins to hardens. The crimson liquid then finally hardens around him, making him completely armored but slower, decreasing the speed from 50 mach to 10 mach.

The ground begins to shake very strong with every stomp he makes as he run towards Melody to rescue her. This however alerts Melody that Kagome is approaching fast to rescue her from the hunters. The hunters stop what they were doing before they quickly turn their body around to the source of a stomping as what they see was a crimson golem with multiple of crimson tentacles waving on his back fiercely. Kagome then quickly turns his right hand into a long, thick crimson one-edged sword before he swipes his blade from right-to-left. The hunters never seen this kind of creatures as they both stand in defensive stance, ready to take on this creature. Sadly, by the time they were ready to fight, their head were crushed like a watermelon as the Kagome’s blade bashes through the trees along with the heads of the hunter with ease. One-tenth of the hunters manage to duck then begins to flee.

But Kagome as an Altair Medelian, prowling for blood and vengeance, isn’t happy to see someone who was hurting Melody running away. His crimson tentacles on his back begins to glow radiant red and orange before they grow ten times longer than before as they all quickly penetrate through the fleeing hunter’s chest. They slowly groan in pain but the groaning fades away as they feel nothing but warmth and heat on their bloody body from Kagome’s radiant tentacles. Kagome then pulls the body towards him before Melody manage to break free from the net by chewing open the net. She then watches the shadowy figure of a large, 8 feet tall Armored Altair Medelian with his protective armor helmet off eating and devouring the burnt hunters from his tentacles. She quickly gets out of the net before she kneels then stares to the ground as she waits for Kagome to finish finishing his meal.

Altair Kagome then finishes his meal before he glares at Melody from above: Melody. Yet. Still. You don’t fight back and use your normal strength and power to defend yourself from these kinds of mortals.

Melody: I-I’m sorry. I told you, I’m not used to be always scary and brutal to my foes even though I must fight back to defend myself. I can’t be just like you, MK…

Altair Kagome: Hmpfh… And why weren’t you in your Celestial God form back then and break free from that net?

Melody: I thought that I would be chasing by some mortals who underestimate the Medelians and… me… But I wasn’t expecting that those who lives here and far more superior than the mortal human beings we’ve remembered back in New-Brick…

Altair Kagome: These are the people that I’m surprised about as they’re also what I may now call them the “Super Human”. There’s also some mythological or fantasy creatures along with different types of humanoids like wolf boys or other monster peoples.

Melody: I-Is that true…? But the question is, what is this place and how did we end up in this place?

Altair Kagome: You mean how did the ENTIRE soldiers including the civilians of the New-Brick ended up in this place?

Melody: You believe that we were somehow drifted or… teleported to a different place as we just watched New-Brick collapsing…?

Altair Kagome: It’s not one of MIN’s nor Chimera’s doing. This just came out of nowhere. It’s new. Natural. This could be a time where others travel to a new place or… to the next survival level.

Melody: Then what will happen to our original home…? My home… Nova Spade…

Altair Kagome: We will find a way to get out of this place but first. We need to know much more about this fantasy land.

Melody nods before she slowly stands up and let a powerful bright white warp in a shape of a diamond with a blue rim surrounding the edge of the sphere sticks on her body and begins to cover her entire body, transforming herself into the counterpart of Kagome’s Altair Medelian: Vega Medelian. With her entire body turning into a beautiful blue, living-space where radiant stars can be seen from her skin, her radiant white eyes like Altair Kagome’s shines like how other beautiful stars are in space before she smiles softly at Altair Kagome.

Meanwhile back at the village where Nilez was finishing his meal at the bar, he walks out of the bar before he stretches. Nilez was a bit desperate and hopeless as Kagome left him alone without saying a single word to him. The villagers around him looks at him in curiosity and fear, they believe that Nilez is a huge threat to them but he didn’t mean to look threatening to the villagers. He sighs before he turns right and proceed forward to walk out of the village. But suddenly a large radiant red figure of a man flies over the village by, followed by a tall radiant blue figure of a woman behind the man. Some of the villager shrieks as they point at them, which alerts Nilez and made him serious curious. Nilez slowly approaches one of the villagers who happens to be a dog boy before he kindly asks him a question.

Nilez: H-Hello there… we happened that maybe some of us do share the same language… but… who were they?

Dog Boy: Aye… I believe it’s the long-waited Altair and Vega…! The strongest Celestial deity who ever stands above all fighters and other deity…!

Nilez: Altair and Vega…? W-Wait a minute…

Nilez begins to have a flashback of him talking with Kagome on the strand near the ZombKing’s campground. Kagome was standing in front of an ocean where the sun begins to set in front of Nilez and Kagome.

Kagome: So Nilez. Every curious of how I become stronger than the time where I showed off my strength?

Nilez: Y-Yes… How did you get so stronger? It’s too fast and early to achieve such energy and power that rivals to… I don’t know… like Gods?

Kagome: It’s a power core we used that belongs to the Celestial beings who falls from their retirement. The last Celestial beings that got retired chose us to claim these energy for the sakes of those who falls or disappears from retirement. There are two. Where one is a power of Destruction, the other is a power of Creation.

Nilez: W-Wait… then that means you have one of those… right? A-are you like a God then?

Kagome turns around before he folds his arms then chuckles: Perhaps… a God I may say.

Nilez: T-Then… what are you then…? What power do you possess...?

Kagome: Hmm… let’s say it took about many years and decades to find out who our true parents are…

Nilez: W-What?

Kagome: You’ll see… Like father and son. I do what my father do, and that is simply…

Nilez: Simply to…?

Kagome grins evilly: …. Destroy.

Coming back to the present time, Nilez gasps as he finally figured out that Kagome now possess the power of Altair. He quickly run towards the direction where the two Celestial beings went before he cocks his Cavalry V-Series while he gives himself a smug look on his face.

“So, you are the strongest, Kagome… But I’m curious… will I be the next?”

title: The Demon from the Underworld (Revamped and Edited)

posts.h:
This is an edited and revamped version of the "The Demon from the Underworld". Featuring more details and other information that may be important to know about the Kagomes and the characters in the story. The storyline of the original will remain the same but there will be some contents that will be changed. Now featuring transcript of the character's speaking.

Chapter 1: The Awakening

In the newly batched of the lands in the New-Bricks, there were many places and dimensions that all Brickman are able to go. From United States to Europe, from New-Brick to the Moon, there’s many other places the Brickman able to travel through different place and dimension, thanks to their advanced, high-technology knowledge and intelligence. With their shared territory and military, the United States and Europe work together as they travel and explore the wide Brick-Galaxy. Maybe they’ll encounter aliens, who are peaceful and offer trades, or maybe an exotic jungle planet where exotic plants and fruits can be harvested. But, have the human Brickman… ever thought a place where the great Demons and Monsters lives in?

Somewhere at the opposite side of the New-Brick, there are three huge and populated lands. Together, the whole lands together are called “Brick-Asia” or “East Brick” for the people of the United States and Europe (or alternatively West Brick). But for the peoples of Brick-Asia: they called themselves Warriors from the Heaven and Hell. The lands of East Brick are divided to three territories: Korea, China, and finally Japan. Most people in that land have even more interesting and extreme technologies and machines which may be find useful for the West Brick. Their weaponry and arsenal are equal and have same high-tech level as the West’s, but rumors have told that they hold a dark and sinister secret which can be dangerous and be an extreme threat to the West. But there were no incident or history regarding about the conflict between East and West. But what are the East Brick doing right now? Are they living peacefully and calmed as the West? Or are they planning to take over the entire world with force and violence?

Meanwhile down to the surface of Korea then to the surface of the mantle of the New-Brick, there is a small underground obsidian chamber. In the middle of the hard, cold obsidian chamber there’s a heavy stone coffin. And inside the coffin, is a man. A man that had many reasons why he was kept down below underground from the surface, awakened as both of his eyes are wide opened. He slowly sits up straight on top of the coffin as he tries to remember from the past, but he couldn’t as one thing he remember that he had a family, a very special and the most lethal family who serves under the ruler of his own kind. He looked around the chamber as he sees only the runes of the ancient time that glows blue dim light that he couldn’t understand what they mean. In front of him are two obsidian doors, locked and shut. He slowly gets off from the coffin before he stretches, not caring that he’s wearing only on his shorts, before he heard the sound of two obsidian doors sliding. He turned around to the doors at it reveals a girl in crimson military uniform with long dark-red hair and yellow eyes, wearing her precise eyeglasses.

He remembers and recognizes the girl by looking at the number “0615” located on the nameplate attached on her right chest area of her uniform. He is her brother, the brother of Kagome #0615. She smiles before handing over his folded blue uniform with an unloaded Delta on top. He slowly dresses himself properly and formally in his uniform before he puts the Delta on his belt. But what’s his name? Why was he inside of the stone coffin down below to the surface of mantle? His name is MK, and he is Kagome #0625, but he doesn’t know the reasons why he was inside of that stone coffin. Yet, he doesn’t’ know how long he was inside of that coffin. His sister leads him to the small, cold metallic elevator before closing the metallic door from the obsidian chamber. She then presses the button on the elevator panels where it leads them straight up to the surface of the New-Brick. Desperate and cold, his sister slowly hugs him from behind before she lets out a small sigh.
posts.t: The Demon from the Underworld (Revamped and Edited)

posts.h:
Kagome0615: Did you miss me, brother?

Kagome0625: Wish I could know the reasons why I was in that coffin for a long time… But, all I know is just you, me, and both of our family members… What happened?

Kagome0615: Let’s just say that we had some… problem and things to be fixed. But we are having a discussion regarding about places and of course the damage that needs to be repaired.

Kagome0625: Damage? What damage?

Kagome0615: Well, it’s not necessary or important to know about… but for now we have some serious problems now. We are currently waiting for your awakening and we knew the perfect time for that to happen. Are you currently hungry?

Kagome0625: No, not really. Let us proceed on with this discussion. What’s about this places you speak of?

Kagome0615: We have to find a perfect place to transfer and live in before the Great War.

Kagome0625: …. The Great War?

Kagome0615: I had a feeling that China and Japan will revolt in our land first then determines who will claim the land. But I presume that we’re worthy enough to claim it.

Kagome0625: Hmm… So a discussion about our plans before things get naughty and destructive, eh? Well that’s just perfect. What places do you believe it’s a right place to transfer?

Kagome0615: We thought about either at the United States or at Europe.

The Elevator stopped at the surface level of the New-Brick before the door opens on its own for them. Kagome0615 and Kagome0625 slowly heads out of the elevator where they walked down to the corridor then to the Meeting Hall. There, BunnyHawk was standing with her mask on at the front of the long table where other Korean Generals and Captains sits on the side of the table as they stood up and salute as Kagome0615 and Kagome0625 approaches the Meeting Hall desk. BunnyHawk, Kagome0625, and Kagome0615 sits down on the end of the table before the rest of the Generals and the Captains of the Korea Military sat down last. They both turned their heads towards the three Kagomes as they sweat nervously because of Kagome0625’s awakening. Kagome0625 stretches his arms and pop some bones on his neck as he stares at them back.

Kagome0625: So, sister. Begin.

Kagome0615: We are now aware that we have a signal and a message from China and Japan as they will prepare the materials and all they can have to begin the Great War. The War between the Three Legendries I may say. However, the bad news is that they will revolt against us first then fight against each other last. Which we will have to find a way to transfer our people and our resources to the safe place first before they begin the war: which I may have to say Europe or United States.

BunnyHawk: But, do you believe that Europe and the United States are proven to be the friendly and harmless to the people from the Three Legendries? They are human, and I believe that they are very defensive and protective from others who invades their lands.

Kagome0625: Our people in this country is also human, BunnyHawk. Correct?

BunnyHawk didn’t say a single world to reply him back before turning her head away from him in embarrassed way. The Generals and the Captains looks at each other as they nodded and begin their conversation. Some believe that they will greet us and be very benevolent to them, some believe that they will defend and protect themselves from the intruders who enters their territory. BunnyHawk looks back at Kagome0625 before she gets up and leaves the Meeting Hall. Kagome0625 quickly gets up as he speaks in confusion.

Kagome0625: Where are you going?

BunnyHawk: To train, before the Great War begins. I don’t want to get started as a rusty lady
.
BunnyHawk leaves the Meeting Hall before closing the doors behind her. Kagome0625 then sits down slowly before shrugging at his sister.

Kagome0615: I did contact the Brick-Force HQ of the United States and Europe about this situation as they seemed to be in the middle of deciding either they will allow us or not. But first we must prepare a right coordinate for our people to transfer. Brother, you will have to go there and set it up for us as I will have to prepare the Kagomes and our soldiers for the war. I bet that you will find something very interesting and amazing over there since you have never been to United States and Europe before.

Kagome0625: I agree, sis. Perhaps I will go alone but on guard as I enter their territory and find a perfect spot for our people to transfer at. Perhaps a flat plain or any peaceful environment near their base would be necessary.

Kagome0615: You always love to dance and train in the flat plain, brother. But of course, that was a long time ago I may say… before you were in that coffin.

Kagome0625: But… Why was I in that coffin?

Kagome0615: There was something you were… too young to notice and understand for your father.

Kagome0625: Ah… perhaps something not suitable for children I presume… Like my friends uhh… uhmm..

Kagome0615 smiles softly: I presume you’re talking about Kagome0312, Mark, and Kagome0213, Jullie.

Kagome0625: Ah yes… Them… Well I should be going to my… room now. Where is the portal to theirs located at?

Kagome0615: At the underground tunnel connected to the underground bunker located at Suwon. You should get yourself ready and be careful out there.

Kagome0625 nods before standing up then leaves the Meeting Hall, leaving his sister to have her conversation and discussion with the Generals and the Captains. Kagome0625 doesn’t know or understand or even remember what happened from the past before he was in the stone coffin. He doesn’t even know how long was he in there as well. But duty calls, as he remembers what his room is located at. He heads down to the corridor of multiple doors and office of other Kagomes that he remembers and some that he doesn’t recognizes before he found a door that is labeled with large text pasted on the top area of the door in blue and cyan “0625”. He noticed that there is a finger print scanner next to the door. He gently presses the scanner’s screen with his thumbs before the screen turns red to green, unlocking and opening the door in front of him. He slowly enters his room as he looks around the room. Everything isn’t messy or dusty at all.

Not a single cobweb, rat holes, debris, or any trash can be spotted inside of his room. The bookshelf that is against the walls of his office walls still remains unchanged and his other interiors. The mixture of cyan and blue ice and glacier artwork on the walls remains the same, including the lighting and the light-provided interiors still emit blue lights unchanged. The two couches facing each other with the table that is about the length of the couches' are also remained the same with his desk in front of them that is at the end of his room. A painting of him posing with a Korean Flag and a Mosquito 1 on the wall doesn’t have a scratch or any marks, but behind the painting is a safe. He slowly approaches to the painting before taking the painting off the wall where it reveals a safe with a keypad.

Obviously, he remembers the password: “19990625” before entering the correct password on the keypad and unlocks the safe. He slowly opens the safe where it reveals a customized Bron Mask that was forbidden and illegal to the human Brickman, and his old fashionable custom Mosquito 1 with an artwork of blue and cyan flame on the middle-body of the Mosquito 1 and a nice blue barrel that replaced the ordinary Mosquito 1’s barrel. Clearly this doesn’t operate and shoots bullets how Mosquito 1 does. Instead, the magazine holds 30 special bullets that contains a powerful liquid nitrogen compacted inside each of the bullet that will be released when enters his opponent’s body, causing his enemies to slowly freezes and suffer from painful cold overtime with his specialized bullet.

He puts his customized Bron Mask on before turning it on and grabs his Mosquito 1. He also remembers the simple name of this custom Mosquito 1: “F. Mosquito”, which F stands for Frozen. A quite simple name that he come up with, but he digresses before he cocks his Mosquito 1 and changes the mode of his visor hud to normal. Apparently, it was set to infrared that he has no idea why he sees everything blue and purple on his visor hud. He closes the safe and locks it before putting the painting back on then leaves his room before locking the door behind him. He looks to his right as he sees no one, then he looks to his left as he also sees no one over there as well. He sighs before he walks down the corridor and proceeds on before leaving the major city of the Korean Military Center as he sees two Colonel Korean Soldiers, guarding the entrance of the building, saluting then return to the position of attention as Kagome0625 walk pass them to the center of the campground that is surrounded by a tall, thick and powerful wall with two massive doors in front of him. He remembers that he’s now located in Seoul. He will have to find a transportation or a way to get to Suwon.

He slowly approaches the door before the Korean soldiers who were guarding the door from the inside opens for him. As he leaves the campground, he looks around as he sees nothing but skyscrapers, cars, peoples, and the signs that is all over the place which says:

Join the army and become a defender of your home from China and Japan for the Great War! Be worthy enough to be chosen to take part of the Intergalactic Kagome Military! Join the army now and show us your skills and your menacing moves to your enemies!

Kagome0625: What a… very nice advertisement for encouraging the people to join the army to prepare themselves for the Great War. But I never seen or heard any new Kagome soldiers joining in the military for a long time now. Just only recruits that turned their rank to Colonel 9 to General Ranks and joining in the space fun. Becoming the soldiers of Kagome is tough and challenging, but with good benefits.

He slowly stands beside the bus stop post as he watches high-speeding cars zooming by in front of him.

“I used to remember how complex and the entire Korea land is changing and evolving every year. From classical and slow cars to futuristic and fast cars. From a small hut to a large restaurant. From a phone with a freaky wheel with numbers to a simple and cellphones that has everything. From no internet speed to a stupidly fast 80 gigabytes per seconds. This entire city has changed a lot. And I just feel like… that this has to either stop, or continue. Because by the looks of these speeding cars: I think they know what’s up. And they know that they will be ready for the Great War. And I will be ready to take on, but I am aware that I’m starting weak, so I must start strong first.”

Chapter 2: Taking a Ride with a Black Crow

Kagome0625 waits patiently as suddenly a long, black car comes in and stops in front of him sideway. The passenger seat’s window slowly slides down where it reveals a man with messy black hair with hairs covering his right eyes in black suit with a dark grey undershirt exposed in the driver seat. Kagome0625 recognize the look of his hair style and the way the man dresses. He is Kagome0421, Dae Jackson, the leader of the Black Hawks, armed with a customized dark-black version of the Hawk 14 on his belt. Dae Jackson is his uncle, who was married to Kagome0505. He never remembers what does Jackson’s wife looks like or what’s her role. Kagome0421 however shows Kagome0625 head gestures to get in the car. Kagome0625 slowly gets in the passenger seat before the driver locks the door and closes the passenger seat’s window then drives in the same speed as the other speeding cars in the road. Kagome0625 looks out the window as they pass through many other speeding cars and buildings in an immeasurable speed. Kagome0421 glances at Kagome0625 before smiling softly.

Kagome0421: It’s been a while now has it, MK? How was your nap down in the uhh… eerie stone coffin?

Kagome0625: It was good, Uncle Jackson. And yes it has been… how long was I in that coffin…?

The tall man then claws on Kagome0625’s bare back with the tall man’s finger as he draws himself a rune symbol.

ㅍㄹㅇㅁ

The gels that is covering Kagome0625’s body begins to go opaque by the time the bright blue moon shines above his body vertically as it begins to float in mid-air along with his body as the gels begins to slowly merge inside of his body. His hair changes from black to dark blue as his vampire fangs are purely white and sharp that is capable of eating and crushing a thick titanium armor with just one small bite with ease.

Kagome0625 then looks around his body as he laughs in excitement and amusement as he turns around facing his body to the tall man and the Blue Bomb-Bee. The bright blue moon then shines above Kagome0625 as he looks up to a moon then chuckles. He can feel powerful energy and adrenaline rushing and travelling around his body in rapid pace. MIN: You two have fun killing and fulfill your duties. I’ll be watching you and will also assist you as your personal world detector. But don’t get cocky… Because I’ll be watching you forever. Kagome0625 smiles: Oh I will… I will enjoy myself once again after all the years have passed… Thank you, MIN… I’ll head down to begin my mission.

By the time Kagome0625 salutes back at MIN, MIN slowly fades away to nothingness. Kagome0625 no longer senses MIN’s energy as he looks around and smiles. He spans and stretches his wings before walking around the roof. He then walks across then stands at the edge of the roof with one feet behind his other feet that is close to the edge of the flat roof then laughs softly. “Finally, after all these years I have waited… I finally got my powers and my energy back… my long-waited wings, fangs, and my elegant blue hair and uniform are always in tip-top shape… Now with my long-waited powers and energy, I can now win this Great War with ease once and for all. Nothing will stop me. Nobody will get in my way. No one will dare to step forward and oppose me… Because I am the Blue Demon…”



End of the Compact Chapter 1

Chapter 12: The Orbital Elevator to the Moon

Meanwhile in Seoul, the sister of MK, SJ, slowly takes a deep breath then stretches as she stands on top of an ascending platform to the highest level in the orbital elevator. The walls of the orbital elevator have multiple of well-arranged of reinforced clear glasses as the outer wall are reinforced and armored with heavy-duty reinforced armor plating to prevent manipulate and control the pressures inside so the glasses wouldn’t easily break and to keep the orbital elevator armored and protected from any invasions or falling asteroids. Around SJ however is surrounded with some crates, vehicles, and some missiles. But, next to her is Kagome0505, Susan Soo Jin who is the leader of the White Fencers, standing next to her. She has smooth white hair with hairs covering her left eyes in white buttoned shirt dress, armed with her primary weapon: Platinum Blasthole Spear. SJ glances at Susan’s weapon as she stares at it for a while in curiousity.

SJ points at Susan’s weapon: Auntie Susan… I never seen or heard of your primary weapon being used in the battlefield before… what is it?

Susan looks at SJ then smiles before inspecting her Blasthole Spear: Oh? You mean this? It’s a mechanical spear that rotates at high speeds to quickly and easily penetrate any object. Afterward, high-pressure plasma will be released from its tip, destroying the object within. The expansion and retraction of the spear are virtually instantaneous, resulting in frighteningly intense damage output. From concrete to thick titanium plating, there’s nothing that can stop its devastating strike. And-

Susan noticed SJ is slowly drowsing and starts to snore quietly while standing. Susan glares at SJ before she smacks SJ’s back tight with an excessive force with her hand, causing SJ to wake up instantly after receiving a sudden shock that travels all around her bones.

SJ quickly shook her head sideway after being snapped in reality: O-Ohh…! S-Sorry, auntie...!! I didn’t mean to sleep…! But yes I have listened everything before you said “stop its” …

Susan sighs: Look, I know this orbital elevator takes about few hours to get up to the level where we can easily travel to the moon with our space shuttles. But you know this is your 4th time travelling to the moon by using the orbital elevator’s, right?

SJ nods slowly, trying not to fall asleep again: Yes, auntie… Wish this could travel faster or have some entertainment to keep us getting ourselves bored and tired... It has been 7 hours already… But at least we’re almost there… Then we can transfer these supplies and equipment to our ancestors and the Kagomes…. Thanks to my brother, most of our equipment and weaponry were safe and secured from the enemy forces with ease…

Susan smiles: Ah… I love that boy… He’s quite a nice brother of yours, SJ. And you do know that today is his favorite day, right?

SJ turns her head towards Susan: His favorite day you mean?

Susan chuckles for a bit: Today’s weather is mostly snowing eventually! And your brother loves snow!

SJ giggles nervously before she curls both of her hands into fists. As few minute passes by, they finally reached to the level where they look up and noticed the bottom of the upper-level floor opens on its own before the ascending platform reaches to the upper level floor. By the time their body made contact with vacuum in space, two tall bunny years and one fluffy bunny tail extends out of their body. The Kagomes uses this method to be close enough to transfer the supplies and others with space shuttles to the moon with ease. The upper floor level of the orbital elevator is a wide-open surface that is a shape of a octagon. Really recommend to wear space suits before reaching to the upper level floor for the human, but the Kagomes however can breathe in vacuum quite easily. Which is some reason why they are the Space Marshals.

There are eight space shuttles ready to be used as there are some Kagomes in SWAT uniform with their ears and tail extended out of their body as they walk and patrol around the upper level surface of the orbital elevator. They are all armed with Tsunami 2S and Beetle 1S and they are the elite soldiers of the Intergalactic Kagome Military. One of the Kagome soldiers walks up to Susan and SJ before he salutes. Susan and SJ both saluted back before they return back to their position. Susan and SJ went up to one of the space shuttles before they turned it on. The Kagome soldiers came across to the supplies and the equipment that Susan and SJ brought as they loads them to the cargo bay. Wondering what does it take to end the Great War, Susan begin to turn on the engine before the elite Kagome soldiers finishes loading up then closes the cargo bay doors. SJ takes the passenger seat before she slowly pulls her spider legs into her body, giving her enough space to sit on the passenger seats.

They begin to depart from the top level of the orbital elevator before they began travelling towards the direction where the moon orbits around New-Brick. They finally reached to the moon surface before they travel across the moon until they spotted a one large shrine where more Kagomes patrols and walks around on the shrine. The center is a large shrine tower as it is surrounded with four reinforced walls with larger houses on the corner attached together. Susan slowly lands on the landing zone as she then turns off the engine and gets off from the space shuttle before SJ does. Some Kagomes comes by to help and carries the supplies and equipment they brought from New-Brick for them as they take them to the center of the shrine. There are multiples of small buildings and watchtower scattered and built near the heart of the Intergalactic Kagome Military. This is a place where the Kagome lives and serve as the Kagome soldiers.

Susan and SJ walk across the road built by the Kagomes then towards the shrine tower at the center of the shrine before they encountered some more Kagomes. There are multiple of crates of foods, supplies, equipment, and weapons in separate crates. There are some Kagome captains that are armed with E7 Plasma Rifle, Starlight, or other weapons that no Brickman from New-Brick have ever seen before. As they enter inside the tower, there are spiral stairs at the middle of the tower, where going upwards leads them to some floors and a meeting room at the top then underground training room, weapon development factory, and finally the Kagome research facility when going downstairs. There are some Kagomes who are infused with different animal species like bulls, dogs, cats, etc. SJ looks around then smiles.

SJ: It’s been a while to be back in our home, hasn’t it?

Susan: That’s right… I heard your brother met your friend named “Melody”… is that correct?

SJ nods: Yes, auntie. Melody was my friend and I admire her respect. I assure you that MK and Melody will make each other as a good friend.

Susan giggles: Oh yes. MK usually is good at making friends! What can possibly go wrong with two of them? I mean of course she is a human but MK is a Kagome like us! I am aware that nothing bad will happen to them, right?

SJ then nods as she slowly heads up stairs and look out the window as she stares at New-Brick. Wondering about how Melody and MK would turn out. Whether Melody would be friendly to him forever or would consider him as an arch rival. But, SJ doubts that they won’t be enemies but as friendly rival perhaps. SJ sighs and closes both of her eyes as she extends her spider legs out of her back then taps at the window frame with the tip of her spider legs.

“Melody. My sweet old friend of mine. If you believe that my brother is considered your worthy foe or a rival then I must warn you that you must not interfere or dare to attack or fight him seriously… My brother is someone that I couldn’t stop him when his body is overwhelmed with rage and hatred… My brother must change to something that we wanted to see… or else he will be the only Brickman that even the Gods can’t stop…”
