No carcasses or corpses of the ink creatures, just only the pool of black ink after death. They all turned their body towards the closed double doors of the large dome building decorated with black ink smudges before they began to knock on the door normally like a normal person. The sound of a whimpering and crying of multiple female Egyptian civilians and other anxious peoples can be heard. Warbad pounds on the door loudly before he gets seriously burning and angry under the burning sun. The four United State soldiers are unaware that that the sun is being covered by dark black omen. The sunlight and the atmosphere start to change slightly darker and eerie as the sky turns mixture of crimson, orange, and black. Flametorch slowly realizes the sudden changes of the environment before he slowly looks up then spotted a solar eclipse happening. Flametorch quickly nudges on Warbad before they all shout at Flametorch for nudging them then suddenly realized what is happening. The other three looks up as they spotted a solar eclipse happening.

Warbad: A solar eclipse?! How?!

Anixian: I don’t know… but I feel something bad gonna happen right now…

The solar eclipse begins to glow radiant orange and red mixture but it flashes a thunder-like red and black mixture sunlight above the large pool of ink before the solar eclipse slowly changes back to its normal sun. The large pool of black ink that they’re all standing on begins to gather together and form itself into a large condensed black ink blob standing up on the floor, causing the entire sandstone floor become perfectly clean except the spot where the large blob is standing on. The blob begins to slowly form and shapes itself into a monstrous black ink bull with curve horns. Anixian pumps his shotgun before he clenches his teeth. The others ready their weapon as IcyTea stands in defensive stance with his pistol pointing towards the bull’s direction. The bull ink roars before it charges straight towards the four soldiers.

Anixian: That’s a lot of bull…

The four soldiers quickly separate before they begin attacking the bull by its side. Warbad quickly swings his sledgehammer sideway towards the bull’s right horn then smashes it as the large bone crushing noise was heard. The bull flail angrily as it lost its horn and received heavy pain and damage from Warbad’s sledgehammer. The bull quickly faces its back legs towards Warbad before it launches both of its back legs towards Warbad’s chest, propelling Warbad across the area after receiving a heavy double kick on his chest. Warbad then slides across the floor with his back lying against the floor, causing his back to burn with ever feet he slides on his back above the burning sandy floor. IcyTea quickly fires his pistol once towards one of its eyes with a large bang and splatter, causing the bull to be half-blinded. The bull hops and flails its entire body angrily in pain as it couldn’t see clearly.

Anixian quickly run towards Warbad as the others are keeping the monstrous black ink bull busy. He quickly picks Warbad up with his arm behind Warbad’s neck then helps Warbad getting up from the floor. Warbad couldn’t feel his chest after receiving heavy kick damage from the bull, nor his bones. The bull then tackles IcyTea and Flametorch at the same time before it turns around and faces its forehead towards Warbad and Anixian. The bull quickly charges towards them with its battering ram head ready for another heavy damage. Anixian grips on the shotgun pistol grip then prepares himself to fire, but Warbad quickly grabs Anixian by his wrist then stares at his eyes with a smile. Warbad carries and grips on the shaft of the sledgehammer as his chest begins to glow dim brown-orange light before it fades away. He can feel a sudden energy and power flowing from his chest.

Warbad chuckles: Let’s do this together…!

Anixian stares at his eyes before he smiles softly: Yeah… just like as always. Together.

Warbad has the ability to convert the damage he received from others on his body to extra energy and power. They both quickly run towards the charging bull before Anixian sidesteps to the right, letting Warbad to go first. Warbad grips on the shaft of the sledge firmly with both of his hands before he swings the head of the sledgehammer from bottom to top under the charging bull’s chin with ease. The bull waves backward after receiving a ridiculous upper cut swing of a sledgehammer before it stands on two of its leg with its front legs and head waving towards the sky like it’s going to trip and lose balance. Before the bull loses its balance, Warbad quickly bows as Anixian quickly run towards behind Warbad then jumps onto his back then jumps again off from Warbad’s back then aims the shotgun muzzle directly straight towards the bull’s forehead.

He then lands on the upper chest of the bull with both his feet separated then shoves the barrel of the shotgun into the bull’s opened mouth then immediately pulls the trigger. Anixian, being a total badass, explodes the entire head of an ink bull to ink splatters in front of IcyTea’s and Flametorch’s uniform with a single shotgun blast. IcyTea and Flametorch received even stickier and darker ink on their uniform that is twice harder to scrape and wipe them off from their uniform. Anixian quickly jumps off from the upper chest of the bull before he lands on the floor with only one his feet then with both of his feet. The Ink Bull collapse to the ground with a large thud with its head blown off as Anixian and Warbad gives them a high-five together. They all gathered around as they both fist-bump together as they all chuckles and cheers like warriors.

IcyTea: That was so freaking amazing, you guys.

Flametorch: Yeah… I’m glad you’re okay, Warbad… Is your chest okay?

Warbad looks down on his chest as he then looks back to Flametorch with a smile: Yeah my chest’s okay. Beside, I’m a strong soldier y’know. I’m Warbad, and I make every war more bad as always.

The both chuckles as they both hugged each other again with a laughter and cheering. But the double doors of the dome slowly open as a small tan little girl peaks behind the door. They both look at each other before they slowly head inside of the dome and looks around. Inside the dome is slightly lit by multiple of bright sparkling yellow star in a glad diamond bottle hanging on the ceiling. The walls are decorated with golden stripes and swirly texture of a wave and polka dot. Pure gold and pure marble the dome is made of, but that doesn’t matter now. The little girl lead the four United State soldiers to the group of livings and surviving Egyptian survivors in traditional long, loose-fitting gown as others dress themselves in loose-fitting trousers and shirts. The civilians make a path for an elder-looking Egyptian man with a long grey beard in luxurious and gilded dress with golden cane with ruby swirly stripes around the shaft walking in the four soldiers’ direction. He stopped as he first bows then looks at them with his grateful eyes.

Altturab: My name is Altturab Aldhdhahabi. I am the prime minister of the Egypt Brick-Force HQ. We thought that you were one of them… but we’re grateful that you’re all soldiers… Where are you from?

Anixian steps forward then salutes: We’re from the United States. We were on a rescue mission to save Melody from the shadow creatures… and also were on the search to find our friend Daxflame, but we have no clue where he went. But we were unconscious and somehow ended up in the helicopters… rescued by someone who we don’t know who they were…

Then Flametorch steps forward and stands next to Anixian: And then we were attacked… causing the helicopters to crash down to your city. I believe we were trying to be sent to any nearby hospital but it turns out these creatures attacked us… and I presume including your people, Altturab.

Altturab rubs his beards as he sighs in grief: Yes… These creatures came out of nowhere… spreading my people and turning them into… one of them. I don’t want my empire to turn itself into black darkness goo... We’re starting to low on supplies and the only soldiers who can fight for us are only you four…

IcyTea folds his arms: Then we can help you. We can find survivor and turns this location into a last living fortress away from these creatures. Do you know where your military is located? We will need firepower and armor then we can do our best to find and bring any living survivors here along with supplies and food.

Altturab’s face lit up: R-Really..?! Thank you! I knew you four will be our only hope… My military is located on the East and West… Thank you… but who are you all?

Warbad then steps forward before he lays his hands on his hips: My name’s Warbad, the Warrior of Strength.

IcyTea points his thumb with both of his fingers curled towards his face: I’m IcyTea, the Ranger of Perception.

Flametorch folds his arms with a smile: I’m Flametorch, the Scout of Agility.

Then finally Anixian puts his hand down: And I’m Anixian, the Soldier of Intelligence. And we’re the veterans of the United State Brick-Force HQ.

Altturab: Thank you…! We’re counting on you boys… We do have some little amount of object and materials to barricade the paths away from the creatures, but if you could bring some more supplies and resources, we can improve and strengthen the defense… Let’s make this location the last surviving place away from these creatures until they’re gone for good…

Altturab bows before them also both bow in front of the United State soldiers. The four soldiers then leaves the dome as the survivors inside, along with Altturab, begins to gather and find any materials and object they can use from the dome to barricade the paths from the Ink Creatures. They all went outside as the survivors begins to work and barricade the path from the Ink Creatures as IcyTea and Anixian head towards East as Flametorch and Warbad head towards West. But the soldiers are unaware that they are being watched from the deep depth of Hell.

Chapter 4: The Ink Lord

Meanwhile back at the dark and the blazing depth of crimson Hell, SJ finally wakes up from unconsciousness before she gets up from the bench then shakes her head to get her nerves and conscious back. She looks around as she spotted a small demonic imp peeking behind the corner. She looks to her right as she sees her helmet resting on the floor. She picks it up before she puts it on then takes a small deep breath. She slowly walks out of the cave opening as she sees multiple of demonic monsters and devils sitting in front of the cave opening, waiting for her awakening from unconsciousness. One elder demon in blood-colored hood slowly steps forward from the group before it kneels on one knee then faces its head down to the ground.

Ecka’chadd: My queen… Are you alright?

SJ slowly stretches: Yes, I’m okay. My brother spared me again… But who knows when my real afterlife will come… and the end of our existence…

One large high-ranking Baron of Hell, Kirao’aoah, steps forward then kneels down in one knee next to Ecka’chadd: The Queen of Hell shouldn’t worry about the end of our admirable queen’s creation. We shall continue to rise and fight, and defend ourselves from the Blue Demon… Your brother however continues to grow stronger even when he passes through his limits… We must find a way to contain him.

SJ rubs her chin slowly and smoothly: MK’s main weakness is his back spines… If we can successfully damage him good enough, his power level will decrease back to its beginning power level… But we need to find a way to make him extremely vulnerable and a way to stop him from moving…

Ecka’chadd: Paralyzing or stunning him is a good way, but he’s now extremely immune to most of our high-level chemical, poisons, and even spells… We need to find something and uses it as a paralyzing and stunning weapon that your brother isn’t aware of…

SJ stops rubbing her chin before she glances down at Ecka’chadd: Something that my brother isn’t aware of…? You mean a new material that can be used to paralyze him? But there isn’t anything we can make to paralyze and stun him…!

Kirao’aoah: My queen… Instead of creating another new weapon to prevent your brother from moving by paralyzing him… how about we could find one…?

SJ tilts her head slightly to her left as she glances at Kirao’aoah: … Find one?

Then suddenly a large moving black ink blob walk passes by as it struggles to pass through the crowd who stand in front of SJ. Chanting and repeating “Move aside” or “Get out of my way” in deep-hatred tone as it uses its monstrous hands to pushes the demonic creatures away from his path, causing any creatures to those who’s being touched and shoved away from the black blob to have a black ink smudge on the spot where the creatures touches at. The demons and monsters of Hell turns around to the black ink blob and hisses angrily, alerting SJ of her creatures and her creation alerted and triggered from someone. The creatures then surrounds the black blob as they all glare at the black blob. The blob growls at them for a warning not to get in its way, but the demonic creatures and monsters makes a path for SJ as she slowly walks towards the black ink blob. The blob turns its half upper body towards SJ’s direction as it continues to growl in anger.

???: What are you looking at, lady?

SJ: Well excuse me but I haven’t seen any creatures or demons who roams around Hell who dares to speak with such a big mouth in front of Queen of Hell…

???: Q-Queen of… Hell? You’re saying that I’m dead…??!!! Pathetic!

Kirao’aoah: Hey you better watch your mouth from saying about our home and our queen’s creation or else she’ll send you straight to a permanent pitch-black afterlife, blob.

The black blob doesn’t say anything as he stares at SJ.
SJ folds her arms: Who are you? And how did you ended up in here?

Ink Lord: Aye, the human mortals and the pathetic Brickman calls me the “Ender Lord” or the “Phantom Lord”… But because of my consequences I have done at the surface of the living New-Brick, my entire body fails miserably as my solid forms starts to spews out an endless black ink out of my bones! Covering and suffocating myself in this thick, dark black ink… I decided to call myself… the Ink Lord.

SJ: Ender Lord? Consequences? Ink? Thick? Ink Lord…? You seem to had a rough day…

Ink Lord: Of course I had! You have no idea how hard-working it is to try and make my ghostly body into a complete solid form!! I have waited for many years to find a source… energy… a consumable that can make my body perfect. But I was then unaware of these Brickmen attacking and saving the source for my body… And then the substances somehow tainted me or gave me a dark and horrible curse to my body! And then this woman came out of nowhere, ruined my entire plan, killed my entire people and my minions, and myself… as I then, thanks to you for informing, I am now in the afterlife in Hell.

SJ: You’re life story somehow attracts my attention.. So are you from the New-Brick? Minecraftia? Terraria? What?

Ink Lord: Aye, “Queen”. I was thee Ender Lord! So it’s painfully obvious that I am from the Minecraftia universe!

SJ: You’re starting to either get on my nerves or starts to entertain me with your stories and your progress you did before your afterlife… The rest of you all leave and return to your home and back to what you’re supposed to do.

SJ gestures the demonic creatures and monsters to leave the area as they all nodded and slowly leaves the area, leaving behind the Ink Lord and SJ standing and facing each other in a dark, dreaded crimson Hell surface. SJ gestures the Ink Lord to follow her as he did, and then they began to walk until they reach the large valley of corpses of mortals and burnt black skeletons resting on the surface of the ink floor. SJ points at them as she glares at the Ink Lord.

SJ: So are you the one who made this mess?

Ink Lord: Aye, of course. The creatures I first encountered and this is where I first ended up at. I exploded into a massive black ink splatter, but my body inside of this black ink blob isn’t damaged or shattered! Which is good news, but I presume the bad news that I must have killed your creatures that belongs to your… creation?

SJ: The one you killed are one of my creatures as some are just pathetic Minecraftian adventurers who always want to visit Hell. And no, I’m the one who make the expansion of Hell as my grandmother was the one created Hell.

Ink Lord: Then where is she?

SJ: Gone. She passes the crown and the staff, the sign of a person who takes control of Hell to my father, then back to me. As I decided to expand Hell and continue to make entire Hell into a blazing punishment for those who dares to disobey the Holy Rules and those who trespass our territory.

Ink Lord: I am not going to judge nor question about Hell but you may be able to help me as I may able to help you…

SJ: Help me as I help you? Are you even capable of stopping my brother who we call him the “Blue Demon” who can’t be stopped and is capable of defeating me? You may underestimate his power but I recommend not to… as he’s the one who confronts God and the Holy Knights first then sent straight to Hell, leaving behind God a scratch and the Holy Knights a serious bruise. No one but beside my brother have ever done that since the existence of God and the balance between Good and Evil!

Ink Lord slowly rubs his chin as he feels amused of what he heard about SJ’s brother: I’m impressed… Perhaps your brother may have a weakness or a way to stop him…

The Ink Lord slowly opens his hand then stares at the string of gooey, thick and sticky black ink on his palm before he grins. He then turns his head towards SJ.

Ink Lord: Actually… There is a way to stop him!

SJ: Excuse me?

The Ink Lord slowly leans close to SJ’s ears as he whispers in dreaded tone in front of her ear. SJ’s face slowly lit up as she slowly nods on every sentence the Ink Lord said to her ears. SJ turns her head towards the Ink Lord as she nodded and smiles before she gives him a thumb up. The Ink Lord was the source of the Ink Creatures roaming around the Egypt Empire. The Ink Lord told SJ that he have four Brickmen that he must hunt down and kill from the surface of New-Brick with his minions and his creation by shoving them to a circular portal that is small enough for his entire hand to fit. He could be capable of heading back to the surface of New-Brick but he couldn’t make it bigger for himself. But the Ink Lord continues to watches the four soldiers of the United States going on their new journey from Hell with his small circular image formed with a purple rim surrounding the outside as the image inside could be seen as if looking through a window. SJ wonders what was her brother is doing as she agrees on Ink Lord’s brilliant plan.

Chapter 5: The Blue Demon and the Turquoise Vanguard

Meanwhile at the Zombie Pigmen Kingdom in the middle of the large lava ocean, the sound of multiple pigs squealing and the sound of fired heavy buckshot were heard all around the kingdom. The workers and the civilians of the Zombie Pigmen Kingdom recoil and scatter across the kingdom in fear and horror as MK, the Blue Demon, begins to fire and kill thousands and millions of Zombie Pigmen in the kingdom. The sound of pumping of a Frostbite 25, the sound of meat and bones exploded to pieces, and the sound of a dreaded squealing of a dying Zombie Pigmen echoes all across Hell. MK walks around in the kingdom’s bailey with his Frostbite 25 pointing towards ever single Zombie Pigman’s forehead and blasting them to billions of micro pixels and bricks. Infants, juvenile, mature, adults, and even the elders are tormented and being sent to a permanent dark afterlife with every shot of his Frostbite 25.

Finally, the warriors and the soldiers of the Zombie Pigmen Kingdom finally arrives and readies their golden double-edged broadsword and their other weaponry as they charge towards MK with a war cry. MK slowly takes a deep breath before also charge towards the charging armed Zombie Pigmen with his shotgun pointing forward before he pounces towards the group of charging bacon soldiers. Then he begins to move his eyes in front of the visor inside of his helmet rapidly as screens and unreadable rune symbols begins to move and shape-shifts into a different rune symbols, including the rune symbol on the forehead of his helmet. As it finishes its shape-shifting to the right rune symbol MK wanted to make, his visors begins to emit glowing dim purple light out of his visor and the weapon he’s carrying. Then the voice of a robotic humanoid was heard inside of his helmet, like an announcer.

Robotic Announcer: Quad Damage.

MK quickly pulls the forend of his shotgun before he pulls the trigger then fires a large, purple, infernal blazing energy orb out of the shotgun barrel then exploded on impact in one of the Zombie Pigmen who were very unlucky to be the first one to be exploded to smithereens then towards the entire group of Zombie Pigman soldiers. Its blast radius is similar to the Atomic Grenade’s but it’s now four times wider and powerful as his visor and his shotgun emits glowing dim purple light. The Zombie Pigman soldiers was separated and launch themselves in random direction from a massive explosion blast before they try to get up and do their best to stop him. MK then lands on top of the unlucky soldier’s pool of blood then rolls forward before he stops with one kneels kneeling down and fires buckshot round of his barrel in one of the Zombie Pigman soldiers’ direction then blast them to pieces. The shotgun blast is of course also four times stronger and powerful than before.

MK quickly gets up before he pumps his shotgun once. Then a large heavily-armored Zombie Pigman soldier charges towards MK’s back before he swings its giant dark obsidian spiked ball mace from right to left towards MK’s side. But MK quickly turns around in lightning speed before he catches the middle shaft of the mace with one of his hand then snaps it in half with ease. The heavy Zombie Pigman soldier raises its eyebrows in shock and in unbelievable sight to see a man like him could catch and snap its mace in half even though it weighs about 5 tons. MK quickly tosses is shotgun high up in the crimson sky then grabs the upper half of the snapped mace with both of his hand like a club while staring at his enemy’s helpless and dreaded eyes then swings it in lighting speed like baseball bat on the side of the heavily Zombie Pigman soldier’s head which causes its head to launch itself off from its body as it then flies across the castle before it lands above the lava sea surface then melts.

He then catches his shotgun falling from the sky by its grip without even saying a single word like a badass and continues his massacre. All of the Zombie Pigman soldiers grips on their weapon tight as they squeal in anger and rage before they charge towards MK from all of his direction. MK quickly pulls out another stone chip from his front belt then squeezes it before he tosses it up to the sky, where it then morphs itself into another Frostbite 25. He quickly sets his shotgun that we was first using firing mode from pump-action to semi-automatic before he catches another shotgun from the air by its grip with his other hand then set its firing mode to semi-automatic, dual-wielding two semi-automatic Frostbite 25s that will only fire heavy buckshot round. However, his weapons and his visor stop glowing dim purple light before it fades away, telling him that his Quad Damage power is already used up and needs to be charged back fully on its own.

MK, a freaking dual-wielding iconic badass that no man can ever become but only in their dream, spins in rapid pace with both of his shotguns pointing towards to every single Zombie Pigman’s forehead individually then firing a heavy buckshot round towards their faces. Blasting and exploding the Zombie Pigman’s head to billions of micro pixels and bricks. A huge volley of pellets and unstoppable firepower, spinning itself into a blazing flash tornado, minces every single Zombie Pigman soldier who dares surround him and underestimate MK’s ability, power, and his cunning skills. Mountain of fired shotgun shells along with mountain of meat and bacons surrounds MK. He continues to fire more and more without even feeling exhausted before he stops in front of the last standing Zombie Pigman soldier then smashes its head to millions of bricks from both side of its head with MK’s shotguns at the same time like two iron balls sandwiching a jelly from both sides.

He slowly wipes off the blood covering his armor with his hands, looking around and checking for any moving Zombie Pigman in the scene. Quiet as the air is filled with ashes and echoes of squealed Zombie Pigmen, he slowly turns and slowly walk towards the path of the exit before he squeezes the secondary Frostbite 25 he was using back to a chip then puts it back to his belt. Then after a few minutes of walking on the crimson bridge above the blazing lava ocean, a large bright turquois circular portal was appeared in front of him. He stops then stands in defensive stances with his Frostbite 25 pointing towards the portal as he waits for anyone to come out of the portal. Suddenly a large stream of blazing cyan and blue lightning explodes out of the portal before it struck down MK as he screams in pain. Heavy and shocking the lightning it is, it begin to malfunction and causes MK’s armor to be unresponsive. Struck in a powerful gulf of blue lightning for half of minute that is three times hotter than the sun, MK finally gave up enduring the pain and the shock before he kneels then immediately collapse to the floor. Then four heavily-armored silver knights in turquois color and with freezing turquois smokes emitting out of their armor’s small gap and opening steps out of the portal before a girl in turquois hooded robe steps out of the portal last then looks down at MK in deep pain and suffering from the lightning.

Lila: Young prince of the Holy Heaven Knights, MK, please rise from the pain you attempted to endured from your queen’s awakening. She had sent me to inform you a message from her.

MK slowly gets up but fails. Then he tries to get up one more time before he manages to stand up but with his entire body shaking and vibrating in shock.


Lila: You have not spoken for 8 years since your 5th birthday. Please, it is best to finally speak for your mother and our queen’s awakening.

MK, a freaking total badass finally speaks as he looks down at Lila: …. What does she want?

Lila: Our queen has been notified from your action and your role to rebalance between the good and evil all on your own. It is best to have a partner or an ally to assist you to accomplish your goal more efficient and with ease.

MK cracks his knuckles as he chuckles: I don’t need assistance or a partner if I’m the one who is responsible for this and the only man who is capable of fighting demons and the demonic forces in solo. So no, and it’s no fun game when someone comes in and take my spotlight. I prefer living and fighting in here as I continue to rebalance between Hell and Heaven by stopping and annihilating the expansion of Hell from my sister. Beside my sister is the queen of Hell and it’s a pleasure to fight her and to be the one who can match up with her.

Lila: But you’re overwhelming strength and power is what awakens the queen and the king of the Holy Heaven Knights. Every pain and damage you endured is always traded for additional power. They do not want to see you fighting and enduring more damage in Hell for a while now. You must take a break or do your role less efficiently as your partners-

MK immediately approaches towards Lila before he pulls the hood backward then smacks the side of her face painfully once. The knights behind her stands in offensive stance as they are tempted to attack MK. But Lila gestures them not to attack as she slowly gets up and drops tears rolling down her cheeks.


MK: I told you. I don’t need partners and I don’t care how much pain I endured. I will continue to fight until I finish dealing with my sister’s expansion for Hell. Return to the Heaven and never talk to me nor see me ever again until I’m done. Understand?

Lila slowly looks up to MK with a large burning blue smack mark on the side of her face as she slowly nods.


Lila: Yes… as you wish… but in case if you really do need partners in a serious situation that you aren’t able to accomplish and handle on your own… Take these…

Lila slowly reaches her hand into her pocket before she pulls out four small bright orbs that glows in the mixture of cyan and dark blue with a texture of living-fire onto them. She then kneels before she handed them over MK.


Lila: These are the main energy and life source of your allies or the chosen ones on which you wish to make them to be your partner. Choose anyone you wish to make them to be your ally and let them swallow the orb and let it process and begin spreading its power and energy into them…

MK doesn’t say anything before he slowly takes the orbs away from her hands then attaches them at his belt: ………………

Lila and the four knights who was behind her slowly leaves as they enter into the portal. The portal then closes on its own vertically before it disappears. MK slowly looks around as he stares at the four orbs he received from Lila on his pocket. He wonders if he really does need partners. If he believes that these orbs are created by his mother along with the queen, then he had no choice but to take Lila’s advice seriously and do what makes them satisfied. MK slowly walks out of the end of the bridge to where he started off before he leaves the Zombie Pigmen Kingdom’s territory then sits on the small crimson rock before he puts his shotgun down to the floor then observes the orbs.

“Partners… Do I really need a partner? Are they all aware that I’m starting to get weaker again…?”

title: Intergalactic Kagome Military (The Kagomes You Didn't Knew)

posts.h:
Hello, Brick-Soldiers and those were interested on reading one of the stories I wrote.

As I decided to pause on writing the stories, I would love to show you the reference sheet of the Kagomes (and mostly maybe some characters that will appear in the later story. This will help you learn and understand the purpose of these Kagomes and their biography recorded from the past till their retirement of serving under their military.

How was this "Intergalactic Kagome Military" created and went so far?
Kagomes are first once born as a small asteroids that was form in outer space then crash down to the surface of the very first planet of Brick-Galaxy was created. Then, their body will begin to emerge out of the small asteroid. Some will born as an infant, juvenile, or adults. Some Kagomes will be corrupted during the process, which will lead them to become the Cannibal Kagomes. The Cannibal Kagomes are the hostile version of the Kagomes and they will attack on sight and do whatever they want to satisfy their needs. Then the first leader of all Kagomes, [REDACTED], took control of the entire Kagomes and form a new government and then finally their first military: the Intergalactic Kagome Military.

Five years after since the first existence of the Kagomes, the first leader appointed Kagome #0107's grandfather to take control of the government and the military to continue the process of killing all of the living Cannibal Kagomes to extinction. The Kagomes were then able to breed and gave birth to infants later on during the time where the second leader take control of the military. Kagomes who were born from the fallen asteroids became rare until today. The Cannibal Kagomes were then extinct approximately 70 years later since the time of the first Kagome existence. There were some Kagomes who had the half blood of the Cannibal Kagome's due to the fact that most innocent female Kagomes were raped by the Cannibal Kagomes during the war of the normal Kagomes against Cannibal Kagomes.

Then, the 3rd leader of the Intergalactic Kagome Military was then Kagome #0107's father. There hasn't been enough information about his accomplishment nor the great achievement he had done during his time as the 3rd leader, but his son, Kagome #0107, Barcko Kim, had lead the Kagomes to evolve successfully. The Kagomes was then endagered when the human Brickmen made contact with the Kagomes. The Brickmen hunted and devoured the bodies of the slain and captured Kagomes so those who ate it will have the ability to travel through different galaxies, dimensions, planets, and throughout the space just like how the Kagomes used this ability during the war. But the Brickmen were then discovered that eating them causes serious brain injury and muscle support failure, which leads the Kagomes to be left alone from the Brickmen.

During the time where Melody was born along with MK (2 years later after Melody's birth), the Kagomes are now able to use the essence of animal's, plant's, and other species types. However, the Kagomes were all then became rabbits before this final evolution (introduced by Kagome #0107) during the time where the third leader takes control of the military where the first test subject seems to malfunction and causes every living Kagomes to spread and be infested with the rabbit's essence like a virus when they used the essence of a rabbit for their first experience. But as Kagome #0107 took control of the military as the 4th leader, there were now Kagomes who have two essence inside of their body, where first is the essence of the rabbit then the essence of any species type they had in their body.

This leads many evolution and many variants of Kagomes during their mating season or when they breed, however this has stopped when the last standing Kagome, MK, assassinated and killed the entire Kagome species for the consequences of assaulting and attempting to assassinate his friend, Melody. The Intergalactic Kagome Military then shuts down and went down to a total collapse as other forces of the IKM who were scattered across different galaxies and planets, unemployed and disregarded from the official IKM. Leaving them no choice but to create their own government for their current location they are stranded on.

Let us begin with Kagome #0625's biography and information.
posts.t: Intergalactic Kagome Military (The Kagomes You Didn't Knew)

posts.h:
Kagome #0625




Name: Min Kyu (MK for short)
Age: 18
Status: Alive
Location: Unknown
Occupation: (Before) Leader of the Blue Fangs Kagomes, Star Angels Kagomes, and Frost Buck Kagomes. (Now) Active Officer of the United State Brick-Force HQ.
Kagome Type: Half Special/Cannibal
Species: (Before) Normal > Demon > Vampire > Vampire-Revenant Hybrid > Blue Fangs (Now) Has the option to choose its species either Kagome or Medelian.

Criminal Record: Assaulted the Kagome Officer for freeing the Vietnamese and German prisoners; Obscuring the process of the Underworld Expansion and being against the process; Responsible for approximately 50 million civilians and soldiers killed in actions alone before the shut down of the Intergalactic Kagome Military.

Information: One of the Advanced Special Kagome Mercenaries who was first near-sighted and extremely dangerous in close quarter combat. He's extremely immune to cold and ice as he wields the power of Valkyrie Star, Argent Energy, and Comet Blue Demon. His first encounter with a Medelian, Melody, was once a rivalry but then now consider themselves as close friends. Where once MK has never experienced the life of the surface since he was born as he lives in lunar base for 10 years then fight to survive in the Underworld for 3 years. He believes that the raindrops was Holy Water or the sound of a thunder was the sign of his pending doom, but Melody taught MK about nature and the life living in the surface as he understands and learns that living in the surface of the New-Brick isn't bad and finds it peaceful and charming to live instead.

He was one of the five Kagomes who had the most body counts who had been through many battles and war. With his sister, Kagome #0615 "SJ", he was once a very clumsy and lovable brother to her. But he lost all of his emotions and interest on everything after the incident of the "Crimson Project" where he was then bitten and transformed into a hybrid of Vampire and Revenant by his sister on purpose when he was at the age of 5. He lost many reputations and interests from the Officers and the citizen of Kagomes and the Koreans due to his unusual behavior until he finally found a way to make him satisfied. At the age of 10 and a half, he was introduced to the process where his sister was expanding the power and the evolution of the Underworld. Where we believed that "he had a message from the light" to put a stop to it. And this is what made MK, still speechless but able to express serious danger and sudden lust for combat and ending the Underworld expansion.

At the age of 13, he was then imprisoned to the stone coffin and seal it away with powerful magic and spells until he was awoken again at the age of 18. The final war between Korea, China, and Japan erupted where it lead nobody victorious but only one last Kageome standing, MK. During the war before everything was lost in the East-Brick, MK learned and understands emotions that humans feel and express. His power, speed, endurance, perception, agility, and flexibility increases as he receive damage on to his body and convert that damage to an increase level for any one of his attribute that was stated back. Making him very dangerous especially when he converts damage from near-death. However, his attributes can reset back to a beginning level once receiving either a concussion nor receive serious damage on the back of his spine, where the back of his spine is his main weak-point.

Today, he's now a Medelian and is now consider himself as "Melody's Bodyguard", but today his current vital sign went missing after the sudden incident of the entire New-Brick surface collapse and break opens where it leads the entire campground (including the ZombKing's campground where MK was last seen) down to a unknown location/dimensions. His current location is unknown but his vital sign rating is still active. He is still alive as the last time we saw that he was with one of the young German soldier named "Nilez" who also went down to an unknown location with MK.

Kagome #0615



Before taking the essence of Melody's


After taking the essence of Melody's

Name: Song So Jung (SJ for short)
Age: 28
Status: Deceased
Occupation: Leader of the Red Claw Kagomes, Blood Knight Kagomes, and Argent Spider Kagomes. And head director of the Crimson project and Argent Energy Facility.
Kagome type: Full Cannibal
Species: Normal > Spider > Demon > Vampire > Crimson Claw

After Death: New-Brick is blessed with SJ's Argent Energy and Adamantite.

Criminal Record: Insulted the princess of the Egypt Brick-Force HQ; Responsible for the death of 500,000 Korean male citizens and soldiers of those who attempted to sexually harass and sexually assaulted Kagome #0615 without a warning; Responsible of 5,000 citizens being infested and transformed into vampires throughout New-Brick from the accidental portal opening of the Crimson project.

Information: One of the highest ranking female officer in the entire Brick-Force HQ and the highest ranking Kagome in Sharpshooter and Marksman class. She was one of the most beautiful female officer alive in the IKM, where many male soldiers and citizens of Korea (including at the IKM) attempted to have a proposal or attempted to win her over. Those who attempted and failed (or found those who find it boring and the waste of time) will be automatically assassinated, executed, sent to custody (for younger males starting from the age of 5 to 17), killed, or even be "one of her menu for dinner". She's capable of devouring and eating human flesh due to her 2nd to 5th specie evolution and becoming full Cannibal.

She was once the founder of the Viper and Snake family where the production of Viper 1 and Snake arsenal began in the IKM and spread throughout the entire Brick-Force HQ countries. Her vision allowed an object to remain relatively clear up to ten kilometers away. This gives her the advantage to have the most sharpest accuracy and eyesight, making her completely lethal and dangerous in an extremely long range when armed with a Viper 1, Snake, or the Crimson Viper. She's extremely vulnerable when blinded from a sudden light-based ability and equipment. With four of her spider limbs that can be grown from her back, she is capable for excellent all-terrain maneuver and mobility during any situation. Her limbs are also capable of tearing and penetrating through thick metal and concrete along with highly developed sensory system.

She began the Crimson project where she wanted to create a portal that leads herself to the Underworld. However once the portal was opened, the spirits of the ancient fallen vampires burst out of the portal opening as it begins the sudden vampire virus outbreak. With the help of her brother who cleans up the entire vampire roaming around Korea and preventing the vampires from spreading, she lost someone she used to like and close to being taken by a man who was a vampire and assassinated by her brother right in front of her eyes. She digressed slowly as she began the next project where she can began to reign over the Underworld as the next Queen of the Underworld like their grandparents. However, this process of expanding and taking over the Underworld was critical and obscured by her beloved brother who turned against her and her plan.

After many years of battle between the two siblings, SJ was victorious but heavily damaged and requires energy and power. That's when the Argent Energy and Adamantite was first discovered in the Underworld. But few years later, she discovered that drinking and eating the essence of Melody's will allow her to gain more power, which it did of course but also making her more beautiful with her hairstyle and color changed along with her new eyesight, accuracy, and long powerful limbs. This however, alerted and enraged her brother. Her 2nd fight against MK on the surface during the final Great Korean War leads her to an embarrassing but pitiful defeat and death, where the entire New-Brick is now blessed with Argent Energy and Adamantite which can be harvested in deeper underground layers. SJ was MK's 5th target during the final Great Korean War.
